## Version impact

The PR title is the source of truth.

- No version marker in the title means `[PATCH]`.
- Use `[MINOR]`, `[MAJOR]`, or `[NONE]` in the title only when intentionally overriding the default.

See [docs/VERSIONING.md](../docs/VERSIONING.md).
